Purpose: Calculates AVG, population STD, lower bound, upper bound, and outlier counts for each independent attribute.
Flags outlier rows and removes any record that contains at least one outlier.
Builds the Pearson correlation matrix on the cleaned independent attributes and identifies any pair above the chosen threshold.
Builds the Diff_Union candidate set by sorting values, computing adjacent differences, selecting the three largest differences, and collecting the responsible values.
Tests only Diff_Union candidate thresholds and keeps the threshold with maximum information gain.
Converts each continuous independent attribute into a binary discrete attribute using the chosen entropy threshold.
Creates Econ-TEST and Econ-TRAIN from the fully discretized Economy dataset using a reproducible, class-stratified random split.
Creates Table A, renames discrete values to I-labels, and converts Econ-TRAIN and Econ-TEST into item transactions for Apriori.
Runs Apriori level by level using the user-selected minimum support count.
Generates association rules from the valid frequent itemsets and computes confidence for each rule.
Applies Format-1-Rules to Econ-TEST and produces one binary prediction per record using a documented tie-breaking/default strategy.
Builds the TP/FN/FP/TN matrix and calculates Accuracy, Recall, and Precision.
